The role focuses on Windows enterprise management, Active Directory, DNS, certificate administration, authentication services, security hardening, and scalable infrastructure. The selected candidate will work remotely while collaborating closely with engineering teams, system owners, and the Infrastructure Engineering Manager. Key Responsibilities Configure and troubleshoot Windows Server operating systems supporting Active Directory, DNS, and Certificate Authorities. Manage and maintain Active Directory systems. Manage DNS, Certificate Authority, Certificate Management, and authentication services including ADFS, SAML, SSO, and OKTA. Apply STIG and VPR adjustments as required. Manage certificate environments to ensure certificates are issued and installed without outages. Develop scripts to monitor and check the health of Active Directory, DNS, and Certificate Authorities. Design, develop, and support scalable, redundant infrastructure across physical, virtualized, and cloud environments. Install, configure, and manage Windows-based Certificate Authority servers. Install, configure, and maintain group management policies, including role-based management. Set up administrator and service accounts and maintain system documentation. Tune system performance and install system-wide software. Apply NIST and DISA security controls and security-hardening changes based on best practices. Validate and implement critical system patches and allocate directory storage space. Improve existing infrastructure using current technology best practices and cross-application integrations. Collaborate with engineering teams and system owners to influence design and architect solutions in multi-tiered environments. Manage project priorities, deliverables, and deadlines. Produce clear documentation for delivered solutions. Support DevOps culture and cross-functional collaboration across development, product, and QA teams. Support development of a data pipeline and machine learning services. Required Technical Skills Microsoft Active Directory. Entra ID/Azure AD. DNS. Certificate Administration and Certificate Management. Certificate Authorities. Authentication services including ADFS, SAML, SSO, and OKTA. Windows Server and Windows OS Tier II & III support. PowerShell and scripting languages. DevOps tools. Workflow orchestration, including workflows executed at predefined times with data dependencies. STIG and VPR adjustments. NIST and DISA security controls. Security hardening. Certificate authorities and certificate platforms including Microsoft, Digicert, Entrust/Sectigo, and SSL.com. Physical, virtualized, and cloud infrastructure. Group management policies and role-based management. System performance tuning, patching, permissions, administrator/service accounts, and system documentation. Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills Experience establishing large computer clusters. Continuous Configuration Automation (CCA) methods for flexible, programmatic infrastructure and application resource deployment and management. Cloud technologies including Entra and AWS. Integrating Windows services such as AD and ADFS into cloud architectures. Networking experience with TCP/UDP, ICMP, DNS, infrastructure services, and security. CompTIA Security+. Microsoft Certified Professional. 3 years of server patching, backups, and permission management. 4 years of experience in an operations role. Government contracting experience, particularly with the DOJ. DOJ or DOD Clearance. Qualifications & Experience Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or related technical field, with 8+ years of systems engineering or administration experience ; or 6+ years with an MS/MIS degree . The broader education requirement indicates a Bachelor’s degree with 8–12 years of prior relevant experience or a Master’s degree with 6–10 years of prior relevant experience. Additional years of experience and/or relevant certifications may be considered in lieu of a degree. 5 years of experience with directory services, including Microsoft Active Directory and Entra ID/Azure AD, Certificate Administration, and DNS. 4 years of experience providing Tier II & III Windows support for Windows OS. 3 years of experience with ADFS, OKTA, or other authentication services. Ability to work effectively with people across disciplines and varying levels of technical experience. Ability to work independently without constant supervision. Ability to communicate complex technical concepts effectively, both verbally and in writing. Willingness to work on-call as needed in addition to regular business hours. Public Trust security investigation required; the selected candidate cannot begin until the customer grants the required clearance. About the Team / Company The role supports the ESA V IT Services program, which provides services to several Department of Justice customers, including help desk, deskside support, Windows engineering and maintenance, managed print services, ITSM, Account Management Services, Cybersecurity, cloud technologies, and other IT services. The position is part of the ESA V engineering team and will participate in daily Teams meetings and ServiceNow ticket flow.

review_candidates.title: Network Engineer
review_candidates.description: Location: Amsterdam Description Are you ready to be the decision-maker for the global network backbone of a world-class cloud platform? We are searching for a mid level engineer ready to take complete ownership of our rapidly expanding data center network across multiple continents. This is an empowering role where you will be instrumental in designing, architecting, and optimizing our complex global connectivity. You will dive deep into cutting-edge technologies, including Juniper EVPN-VXLAN, and advanced routing protocols (BGP). Critically, while you will own the network domain, you will also be deeply embedded in the wider Infrastructure team. This provides a clear, defined path for you to grow into all areas of our Infra stack—from Linux compute and storage to Kubernetes and site reliability engineering (SRE). If you are passionate about building resilient, secure, and scalable networks, and are eager for a role where your expertise acts as the core architectural decision-maker with clear opportunities to expand your career into overall infrastructure leadership, we can’t wait to connect with you. This is a 5-day in-office position built for maximum impact. Direct, high-bandwidth collaboration is key to the level of Network Ownership and accelerated cross-functional growth we offer. Be in the room to influence architecture, partner with senior leadership, and make immediate, high-stakes decisions that drive the business forward. We believe that we are better together than apart. Key Responsibilities This role is for an engineer who will support network architecture while contributing across the broader infrastructure. Implement, optimize, and scale the global data center backbone to ensure high availability and security. Contribute to the implementation and refinement of Juniper EVPN-VXLAN fabric for scalable overlay networks in our cloud environment. Configure and manage mission-critical routing protocols (BGP,IPSec,ICCP) to ensure resilient, high-performance global connectivity. Configure and maintain security policies using enterprise-grade firewalls (Fortinet, or similar). Collaborate with Infrastructure, SRE, and Development teams to integrate networking solutions with compute, storage and cloud systems (Kubernetes/Ceph). Develop and maintain automation scripts (Python,Bash,Ansible) to streamline network provisioning and scaling. Utilize and support network observability tools (Prometheus,Grafana) for infrastructure monitoring and insight. Provide effective troubleshooting and resolution for network incidents of varying complexity to minimize downtime. Requirements 3+ years of hands-on experience as a Network Engineer proficient in Juniper EVPN-VXLAN, advanced routing, and enterprise firewalls. Working knowledge of core routing protocols BGP/IPSec for scaling global data center networks. Strong proficiency in Linux and proven ability to automate tasks using Python, Bash, or Ansible. Practical experience with Prometheus and Grafana for proactive network monitoring and actionable insights. Experience in configuring firewalls and implementing network security best practices. Ability to independently troubleshoot and resolve complex network and infrastructure issues. Proactive approach to learning and adopting new technologies across the infrastructure stack. Willingness to occasionally travel to data centers for on-site deployments and maintenance. Nice to Have: Advanced troubleshooting utilities: grep, awk, sed, and tcpdump. ​​​​​​​Implementing Anycast for scalable network resilience. ​​​​​​​Integrating network solutions with Kubernetes and CNI. Optimizing performance on Juniper QFX series switches. Why work for us? We are a Great Place to Work-Certified™ company and the global leader in cloud-based access control and video surveillance. Following our merger with Eagle Eye Networks, we are building the only platform powerful enough to support the future of AI-driven security. Why Your Work Matters Innovation drives our vibe, but purpose drives our mission. You will work on essential systems that protect the health, safety, and welfare of people and property worldwide. At Brivo, your voice is heard, your talent is respected, and your contributions have a global impact. The Brivo Experience: We thrive on in-person collaboration and a "one-team" atmosphere. We embrace our international presence, leveraging diverse ideas and backgrounds to improve our culture and our products. To keep our global teams connected and inspired, we provide a premium onsite experience featuring communal meals, recurring social events, and fully stocked workspaces—ensuring you have everything you need to stay focused while building the future of security. Total Rewards: Diverse team with 20+ nationalities 23 paid holidays yearly + Dutch public holidays Compensation for travel expenses from your home to the office; Company equipment for work use; Enrollment in our collective pension plan; Drinks, Snacks, & fully subsidized lunch at the AMS office; Company swag, business casual scale-up work atmosphere and after work drinks; Once or twice a year a stunning company day; Individual compensation packages are based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, training, and market conditions. In addition, Brivonians enjoy a robust benefits and perks package tailored to their work location. About Brivo Brivo and Eagle Eye Networks have come together to create a category-defining, cloud-first platform at the intersection of AI and the physical world. Our mission is simple and ambitious: to make physical spaces safer, smarter, and more autonomous—from single-site businesses to global enterprises. As the unified global leaders in cloud-based access control and video surveillance, we provide a comprehensive digital foundation for the built environment. By combining Brivo’s pioneering building access platform with Eagle Eye’s AI-powered video management system (VMS), we have created a system of intelligence that protects over 600 million square feet across 90+ countries. Every door, camera, and credential in our ecosystem acts as a real-time sensor, leveraging AI to prevent incidents, improve operations, and enable entirely new workflows across sectors, including commercial real estate, retail, healthcare, education, and critical infrastructure. With a global footprint spanning headquarters in Bethesda, Maryland, and Austin, Texas, and international offices in Amsterdam, London, Bangalore, and Tokyo, we are leveraging our open APIs and cyber-secure cloud infrastructure to reshape the future of physical security. Join us as we build the world’s most robust platform for video intelligence and smart space automation. Learn more at www.brivo.com. Brivo is an equal employment opportunity employer and values diversity. Qualified candidates are considered for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, military or veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodations during the application or interview process, please inform us.

review_candidates.title: M365 & AI Infrastructure Engineer
review_candidates.description: Meriton is a national team of experts driving HVAC innovation through a network of high-performing companies. From strategy and support to systems and solutions, we work behind the scenes to strengthen operations and build value—for our partners and our people. If you’re looking to make an impact, we’re glad you’re here. At Meriton, you’ll join a team that believes in big ideas, doing great work, and building careers that matter—every step of the way. M365 & AI Infrastructure Engineer Reports to: Senior Manager, Workforce Productivity FLSA Status: Full time, Exempt The Opportunity The AI Tools & M365 Integration Engineer will serve as a deep technical expert responsible for the administration, configuration, integration, and advanced support of enterprise AI tools within the company's Microsoft 365 productivity ecosystem. This role will focus on maintaining AI tool configurations, integrating AI capabilities with Microsoft 365 products, and ensuring AI services are reliable, supportable, and aligned with enterprise security and governance standards. The engineer will work closely with Workforce Productivity, Technology Transformation, Service Delivery, Microsoft 365, Identity, and Cybersecurity teams. The role will provide L2/L3 engineering support and help operationalize AI use cases developed through the company's broader AI enablement efforts. Responsibilities AI Tools Administration and Platform Ownership Administer, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise AI tools and approved AI platforms. Own platform settings, access controls, feature configurations, connectors, integrations, and operational standards for AI services. Monitor platform health, service changes, licensing, usage, and configuration dependencies to maintain reliable production services. Maintain technical documentation, configuration baselines, support procedures, and knowledge articles for AI platforms. Microsoft 365 Integration Integrate AI capabilities with existing Microsoft 365 products, including Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Exchange Online, Power Platform, and related collaboration services. Support and administer Microsoft 365 Copilot, tenant configuration, licensing and connector infrastructure for approved ai agents. Configure secure integrations using APIs, Microsoft Graph, Entra ID application registrations, authentication, permissions, and connectors. Partner with Microsoft 365 platform owners to ensure AI capabilities align with existing architecture, governance, and support models. Service Delivery and L2/L3 Engineering Support Serve as the L2/L3 escalation point for Service Delivery on AI tool incidents, configuration issues, access problems, integration failures, and complex user-impacting issues. Lead troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, vendor escalation, and long-term remediation for recurring AI platform issues. Support production readiness for new AI capabilities by defining support models, runbooks, monitoring, and operational handoff requirements. Develop PowerShell, scripting, or automation where appropriate to improve administration, reporting, provisioning, and support efficiency. Cybersecurity and AI Enablement Alignment Partner closely with Cybersecurity to ensure AI tool configurations, integrations, permissions, and data access align with enterprise security and governance requirements. Implement approved controls for identity, access, data protection, application permissions, logging, monitoring, and secure use of enterprise AI tools. Work with Technology Transformation and business partners to operationalize approved AI use cases and integrate them with existing Microsoft 365 capabilities. Help translate new AI capabilities into secure, scalable, and supportable enterprise services without duplicating business-facing AI transformation ownership. Qualifications 7+ years of progressive IT experience, including significant experience administering Microsoft 365, collaboration, automation, or enterprise SaaS platforms. Strong hands-on experience administering enterprise AI tools, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Azure AI services, or similar platforms. Deep working knowledge of the Microsoft 365 ecosystem, including Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Exchange Online, Power Platform, and Microsoft Graph. Experience configuring connectors, APIs, enterprise data sources, authentication, permissions, and platform integrations. Strong understanding of Microsoft Entra ID, application registrations, identity, access management, and enterprise authentication concepts. Experience providing L2/L3 technical support and troubleshooting complex platform, integration, access, and service issues. Good understanding of cybersecurity, data protection, AI governance, and secure integration practices. Strong documentation, communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills, with a hands-on and service-minded approach. Preferred Skills Experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot administration, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry / Azure AI, Azure OpenAI, or related Microsoft AI capabilities. Microsoft AI and M365 certifications or Applied Skills credentials are preferred, including Microsoft 365 Copilot and Agent Administration Fundamentals (AB-900), Microsoft 365 Administrator (MS-102), and relevant Microsoft Applied Skills for Copilot Studio, AI agents, or securing AI solutions. Practical experience using and supporting leading Generative AI platforms such as ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot, and similar enterprise AI tools. Experience configuring AI agents, connectors, APIs, integrations, permissions, enterprise data sources, and authentication across Microsoft 365 services. Knowledge of Microsoft Purview, Defender, Entra ID, AI governance, Responsible AI, data protection, and security controls relevant to enterprise AI and Microsoft 365 integrations. Experience with PowerShell, Power Automate, Microsoft Graph API, scripting, and administration automation. Azure AI Apps and Agents Developer Associate or equivalent hands-on AI integration experience is a plus. Having SharePoint Development Experience is a plus.
